card.name: Linking words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words in label instructions that come just before an object or condition, such as 'with' after 'Take DRUG', 'initiate' before 'appropriate workup', or 'itant' in 'concomitant'.

modes.label: With after administer/take
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'Take' or 'Administer' plus a drug name, leading into food or other drugs.
modes.example: 2.4 Administration Take TALZENNA<< with>> or without food.

modes.label: Action verbs in management advice
modes.description: Verbs like 'initiate' or 'given' that introduce a treatment or workup step.
